points.text: Merck signed an R&D collaboration with Infinimmune to discover immune cell-directed antibodies for multiple targets.
Regeneron Pharmaceuticals advanced its antibody pipeline with FDA approval for EYLEA HD dosing intervals up to 20 weeks for retinal diseases.
Context Therapeutics received FDA Fast Track Designation for CTIM-76, a CLDN6 x CD3 bispecific T cell engager, for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.
South Korea’s biosimilar market is projected to grow from around $530 million in 2023 to over $1 billion by 2027.
Adagene Inc. announced a clinical collaboration with Incyte to evaluate Muzastotug in combination with Incyte’s TGFβR2xPD-1 bispecific antibody for microsatellite stable colorectal cancer.
EMA recommended marketing authorisation in the EU for Imdylltra to treat adults with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.
Celldex Therapeutics announced the pricing of a $300 million public offering of common stock to fund commercial launch activities for barzolvolimab.
Merck initiated a pivotal phase 2b/3 trial for the investigational bispecific Tiespectus designed as a tie2 agonist and VEGF inhibitor for neovascular age-related macular degeneration.
Industry experts identify manufacturing and quality control operations as the definitive barrier to patient access for biologics and advanced therapies.
The radioligand therapy market is projected to reach $10.72 billion by 2030, reflecting broader industry growth in targeted cancer treatments.
Merck — Infinimmune Antibodies — Autoimmune — R&D Collaboration (Up to $838 million)
Regeneron — EYLEA HD — Wet Age-Related Macular Degeneration — FDA approval for dosing intervals up to 20 weeks.
Context Therapeutics — CTIM-76 — Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer — FDA Fast Track Designation.
Adagene and Incyte — Muzastotug and INCA33890 — Microsatellite Stable Colorectal Cancer — Clinical collaboration for Phase 1 study.
Celldex — barzolvolimab — Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria — Commercial launch preparation following $300 million public offering.
Zymeworks — ZW191 — Advanced or metastatic platinum-resistant ovarian cancer — FDA Fast Track designation granted.
Biocytogen — Not specified — Weight loss — Strategic partnership with Sihuan Pharmaceutical.
Merck — MK-8748 (Tiespectus) — Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration — Initiated pivotal phase 2b/3 trial.
Earendil Labs — HXN-1001 — Ulcerative Colitis — Phase IIa trial dosed first patient.
Roche — Glofitamab — Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma — Phase 3 STARGLO trial resulted in negative ODAC vote.
Merck: Expanding presence in biologics development — Infinimmune collaboration for immune cell-directed antibodies.
Regeneron: Expanding genomic and proteomic EHR-linked database via TriNetX collaboration while commercializing EYLEA HD.
Context Therapeutics: Advancing T cell-engaging bispecific antibodies for solid tumors including CTIM-76.
Adagene: Transforming discovery of novel antibody-based cancer immunotherapies using SAFEbody precision masking technology.
Celldex: Strategic objective to fund commercial readiness and bispecific antibody platform growth; associated drug barzolvolimab.
Zymeworks: Strategic objective to advance antibody-drug conjugates and multispecific antibody therapeutics; associated drug ZW191 and zanidatamab.
Biocytogen: Strategic objective involves weight loss partnership and antibody platform licensing. Associated program: RenNano platform and weight loss partnership with Sihuan.
Earendil Labs: Advancing HXN-1001, a half-life extended anti-TL1A antibody, through Phase IIa trial in ulcerative colitis.
AbbVie and Genmab: Assessing epcoritamab-bysp (Epkinly) in the phase 3 EPCORE DLBCL-1 trial for relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
Celltrion: Capturing biosimilar opportunities in the 'third wave' of high-value therapies — CT-P51, CT-P44, Eydenzelt.
Infinimmune Antibodies — Immune cell-directed antibodies targeting IL-22 and IL-13 — Preclinical/Discovery — Designed to improve safety and efficacy of existing drugs.
EYLEA HD: Vascular endothelial growth factor inhibitor, Phase 3 (PULSAR/PHOTON), wAMD/DME, 96-week data showed 47% of wAMD patients attained ≥20-week intervals.
CTIM-76: CLDN6 x CD3 bispecific T cell engager, Phase 1a, Ovarian/Endometrial/Testicular cancer, 12 patients treated with no DLT observed.
Muzastotug: Antibody-based therapy, Phase 1b/2, Late-line Microsatellite Stable Colorectal Cancer, 31% confirmed overall response rate in combined 20 mg/kg dose cohorts.
barzolvolimab: Antibody-based therapeutic, Phase 2, Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria, improvements seen across all six DLQI Domains.
MK-8748: Intravitreal antibody therapy; Phase IIb/III MALBEC trial compares two dose levels vs aflibercept 2mg in neovascular AMD.
HXN-1001: Half-life extended anti-TL1A antibody; Phase IIa trial assesses safety, tolerability, PK, and preliminary efficacy vs placebo in ulcerative colitis.
Amivantamab: Bispecific antibody; Subcutaneous formulation in PALOMA-2 trial showed 85% response rate and median PFS above 26 months in EGFR-mutated NSCLC.
Glofitamab: CD3xCD20 bispecific antibody; Phase 3 STARGLO trial led to negative ODAC recommendation for registration in DLBCL.

Daratumumab/Isatuximab: Anti-CD38 monoclonal antibodies, Phase 3 CEPHEUS and IMROZ trials, transplant-ineligible newly diagnosed multiple myeloma, endpoints include MRD negativity and progression-free survival.
Merck — Infinimmune — R&D collaboration worth up to $838 million in upfront and milestone payments.
Regeneron and TriNetX: Strategic collaboration where Regeneron will invest up to $200 million to access de-identified health data.
Adagene: Underwritten public offering of 18,666,000 American depositary shares at $3.75 per ADS for approximately $70.0 million gross proceeds.
Celldex: Underwritten public offering of 10,345,000 shares of common stock at $29.00 per share for approximately $300 million gross proceeds.
Biocytogen granted Taisho Pharmaceutical a license to its RenNano fully human heavy chain-only antibody discovery platform.
Biocytogen and Sihuan Pharmaceutical entered a strategic partnership in weight loss and beyond.
Earendil Labs and Sanofi forged a deal valued at approximately $2.56 billion to advance bispecific antibodies for autoimmune diseases.
Eli Lilly and POINT Biopharma: Acquisition of POINT Biopharma Global Inc. for $1.4 billion completed in December 2023.
Celltrion — Expansion of Incheon facility — Committed 1.2 trillion won ($805 million).
